en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, ornate multi‑storey building on a slight hill, surrounded by trees and a wooden picket fence. The architecture features steep gabled roofs with small roof turrets, arched windows, timber-framed gable details, and a long veranda or balcony along the main façade. In the foreground is a fenced garden or orchard area with young trees; in the background a forested hillside rises behind the building. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image.
